findings.title: Accepted flow return criterion is not implemented
findings.statement: The implementation fails the accepted requirement to restore comparison facet and scroll anchor after evidence return.

severity.rationale: A critical accepted journey requires repeated reconstruction and fails its explicit criterion.

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Return navigation does not restore route-addressable selection state.

recommendation.action: Implement the accepted route-state restoration behavior without changing the approved flow or visual language.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The accepted flow criterion and remediation assertion both pass.

verification_method.procedure: Execute the accepted flow contract procedure and assert facet plus scroll restoration.

evidence.exact_observation: Facet and scroll restoration assertions failed after browser Back.
